items.summary: The Owls erased a 28-0 deficit and tied the game at 35, only to fall inside the game's final two minutes.

items.title: Bermudez Makes History; Temple Falls to Navy on the Road
items.summary: ANNAPOLIS, Md. – Temple erased a 28-point deficit and tied Navy late in the fourth quarter, but the Midshipmen scored with 1:14 remaining to edge the Owls, 42-35. Temple falls to 2-7 overall and 1-4 in American Conference play, while Navy improved to 3-6 and 2-4.

items.title: Atton Named to Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: Augusta, Ga. – The Augusta Sports Council announced Thursday the midseason watch list for the 2026 Ray Guy Award. Temple punter Dante Atton is on the list ahead of week ten of the college football season.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 8
items.summary: It was a career game on Sunday for Titans' linebacker Jacob Martin (2014-17). He dominated on defense, recording a career-high three sacks and five total quarterback hits. Martin now leads the Titans with 6.5 sacks on the season. Tight end David Martin-Robinson (2018-23) recorded two special teams tackles as the Titans fell to the Bengals, 43-36, in overtime.

items.title: Monday notebook: K.C. Keeler talks Navy, Peter Clarke's season-ending injury
items.summary: K.C. Keeler wrapped up conversation about Saturday’s 17-9 loss at East Carolina, looked ahead to Saturday’s road game at Navy and provided some injury updates during his weekly Monday media availability at Edberg-Olson Hall.

items.title: Game Time Announced for Temple Football vs. UAB
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA - The American Conference announced Monday afternoon that on Saturday, Nov. 14 the contest between the Temple Owls and UAB Blazers in Philadelphia will kickoff at 1:00 p.m. The game will be at Lincoln Financial Field and will be streamed on ESPN+. Fans can also listen to the game at owlsports.com/listen.

items.title: Game Guide: Navy
items.summary: PHILADELPHIA – Temple football continues its two-game road stretch on Saturday, November 7, when the Owls travel to Annapolis, Md., to face Navy at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium. Kickoff is set for 3:30 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network. Temple enters the matchup at 2-6 overall and 1-3 in American Conference play, while Navy is 2-6 and 1-4 in league action.

items.title: Temple Drops Hard Fought Battle to ECU on the Road
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. – Temple football battled East Carolina on the road Saturday afternoon but fell, 17-9, at Dowdy-Ficklen Stadium. The Owls moved to 2-6 overall and 1-3 in American Conference play, while the Pirates improved to 4-4 and 2-2 in league action.

items.title: Owls in the NFL - Week 7
items.summary: Kicker Brandon McManus (2009-12) made his return to the NFL this Sunday as he was signed by the Los Angeles Rams earlier in the week. While he did not attempt a field goal in the game, he was perfect in PAT attempts going 5/5. The Rams went on to defeat the Raiders, 35-21.
